title: Find Longest Awesome Substring
goal: Find the longest digit substring that can be rearranged into a palindrome.
strategy: A palindrome permutation has at most one odd count. Two prefix masks therefore may be identical or differ in one digit bit; compare each current mask against the earliest occurrence of those eleven possibilities.
